company.name: Kita
company.shortDescription: Kita is an insurance company that offers carbon insurance products and services that cover risks impacting carbon market stakeholders.
company.description:
Bridging the insurance and carbon markets, Kita offers a bespoke portfolio of carbon insurance products that act as a stamp of confidence and safeguard against loss. Carbon insurance helps to de-risk engagement in the carbon markets.

We protect clients against loss of carbon credits due to risks such as natural catastrophes; fraud and negligence; insolvency and abandonment; political risks; and changing carbon standards. Insurance claims can be paid in cash or in replacement carbon credits, providing flexibility for clients' individual risk appetites and carbon strategies.

With reduced risk in the carbon transaction, high quality carbon solutions are able to access greater flows of consistent capital to scale their impact faster, while buyers and investors gain confidence that they are protected against unexpected loss.

We cover the future so that you can act now.
